expected_form.resumen: Office-wide network outage from a failed core switch; network restored in an hour and a half with a spare switch.
expected_form.que_paso: The outage started early: around eight fifty reception called because there was no internet in the whole office and no IP phones either; on inspection the core switch was not responding and the status LED stayed orange.

timeline.evento: Reception call reporting the office-wide network outage
Core switch identified as the cause after a diagnostic test
Core switch swapped for a spare unit
Network restored: email and IP telephony back up

action_items: Buy another spare switch for the warehouse
Tell the systems lead when they do the node maintenance

user_utterances.text: Can you hear me OK?... OK, I'm on my way out, in the van, just finished the network job at Kimsa... help me out with the incident report, alright?

Well, the outage started early... around eight fifty reception called me that there was no internet in the whole office, no IP phones either... I went in to check and the core switch wasn't responding, the status LED just stayed orange.
OK... the reception call was at eight fifty, log that one first.
That's it... then around nine fifteen I had it pinned to the core switch, because I tested it with the diagnostic kit and it wouldn't answer.
At ten ten I put in the new spare switch I had with me... and by ten twenty I had the whole network back up, email and phones.
Well, the internal DNS went down, that was the first one... and the VPN too, because the delivery crew couldn't get into the system from the street.
Put it down as high... they went about an hour and a half without invoicing or shipping, that hurt.
Yes, that's right... and leave two follow-ups: get me another spare switch for the warehouse, and tell the systems lead when they do the node maintenance.
That's fine... send it now, I've got another job waiting.
